data: Apple delivered solid fiscal 2022 results, with revenue rising 7.8% to $394.3 billion from $365.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Profitability kept pace with the top line. Gross profit reached $170.8 billion in fiscal 2022, up from $152.8 billion in fiscal 2021, for a fiscal 2022 gross margin of 43.3%. Operating income climbed to $119.4 billion in fiscal 2022 from $108.9 billion in fiscal 2021, giving a fiscal 2022 operating margin of 30.3%. Net income grew 5.4% to $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022 from $94.7 billion in fiscal 2021, slower than revenue growth. Diluted EPS rose to $6.11 in fiscal 2022 from $5.61 in fiscal 2021. Apple also increased investment, lifting R&D expense to $26.3 billion in fiscal 2022 from $21.9 billion in fiscal 2021. We see strong margins combined with rising spending on innovation as supportive of the long-term thesis.
